articles.title: Trump seeks meeting with Gadi Eisenkot if he becomes Israel's next prime minister: Report
articles.description: The White House is reportedly arranging a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Israeli leader Gadi Eisenkot if he successfully forms a government. Eisenkot aims to discuss Iran, preserve US military aid, and continue regional talks while racing to build a parliamentary coalition before the December 16 deadline.
